reason: I will need a renovation crew for the kitchen, bathroom and floors, but I would hire from people I know before I pay a platform to introduce me to strangers. I cannot judge the fee when no price is written down.
objection: I don't know yet whether the platform's fee is worth it, since the price is not stated, and I still have to trust whichever builder it puts in front of me.
would_change_my_mind: A stated price up front, plus proof that the builders are vetted and that the escrow payment protects me if the work goes wrong.
